verdict.rationale: Conductor documents its own automation paths. Routines let agents run on a schedule or be triggered via a GitHub Action, which covers CI. The Conductor API lets you create cloud workspaces, send prompts and read replies programmatically, and cloud agents keep working after you close your laptop. However, the core product is a Mac desktop app, and the CI/GitHub Action support appears only as a single changelog line with no setup or configuration docs. missing for 10: a documented headless CLI or non-GUI mode for the app itself, detailed GitHub Action/CI setup documentation, a published OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Introducing routines! You can now run your agents on a schedule or via GitHub action.
Use it to do things like: Create workspaces, send prompts to the coding agent, and read its replies.
Sandboxes spin up in seconds, and agents keep working after you close your laptop.
